reason: B is the better proposal because its annealed-versus-as-received comparison directly tests whether microstructural heterogeneities govern oxide disruption, whereas A only compares temperature regimes and cannot isolate its claimed grain-boundary mechanism; A’s cited fluoride-salt Mn-buffering evidence is also not relevant to native-oxide failure in Q235. B remains imperfect because annealing introduces confounders and it provides no supporting evidence, but it is more causally testable and falsifiable.
